Asset type: a polished mobile landscape WeChat roguelite game's CHARACTER SELECTION screen, one finished screen only, flat front-on screenshot, approximately 2048x960 extra-wide 2.13:1 aspect ratio. No device shell, no poster presentation board, no annotations outside the UI.

Keep the funny Three Kingdoms bean-shaped chibi character identities and handmade cartoon art direction. The reference is an identity and game-context reference, NOT a layout to preserve. Recompose the interface.
Design direction: humorous Chinese peach-orchard adventure, tasteful warm parchment, desaturated jade green and vermilion accents, expressive dark ink outlines. Soft moss/ink green illustrated panels, simple lightly irregular corners and narrow borders, no thick layered gold/wood ornamental frames. Hero illustrations occupy 70% of tile, readable full bean-body silhouettes, tiny simple feet, oversized heads, expressive arms, no long legs. Cream Chinese hero name at lower part of each tile, small restrained role chip underneath. LEFT: Liu Bei, sly smug eyebrows, mischievous chubby face, blush cheeks, topknot with olive headband, short green robe and red sash, one woven STRAW SHOE firmly GRIPPED in EACH HAND, never dangling from fingers. Name "关羽", role "远程 · 穿透". RIGHT: Zhang Fei, wild short black hair and scruffy beard, round eyes and loud laughing open mouth, plum-purple robe, holding a tiny peach blossom branch with a restrained pink magic spark. Both buttons completely visible above the safe area; they must not be cropped as in the reference.
Typography: natural polished Chinese game typography, restrained expressive brush logo, very clear rounded bold Chinese for names and buttons, legible neutral Chinese for trait text. Exact Chinese words, no English words, no invented labels, no random tiny typography. No external watermark or company logos.
Quality: finished professional GAME UI art direction, dramatically better composition than the reference, readable at phone size, excellent spacing and coherent color hierarchy. Preserve humor and charm while simplifying the UI.
